lines: “莫阳，四长老已经死了，你还有脸跪在这里？你该以死谢罪！”
“四长老因你而陨落，让我灵虚宗蒙受巨大损失，你死不足惜！”
“修炼这么多年，连凝气境都踏不进去，莫阳，你就是一个废物，灵虚宗不养废物，滚出灵虚宗！”
“四长老已经陨落了，再无人护着你，宗主已经下令自明日起，木峰并入主峰，今后灵虚宗再无你的立足之地！”
灵虚宗后山，一座衣冠冢前，一个十五六岁的少年神色呆滞的跪在那里。
面对十余名宗门弟子的各种呵斥和怒骂声，有人甚至手指都指到了他额头上……
但他恍若未闻……
表情木纳，眼神空洞，犹如一具行尸走肉。
他就是莫阳！
如今木峰仅剩的弟子。
木峰本是灵虚宗的五峰之一，但这些年来却彻底没落。
因为四长老常外出为他寻求各种药材，无心顾及木峰的诸多事宜，宗门对此异常不满，曾经木峰的弟子要么被宗门直接撤走，要么自行加入其他几峰，木峰早已没人了。
此次木峰被合并，莫阳早已有预料。
只是真的到了这一天，他心中还是莫名的失落。
看着眼前那新垒的衣冠冢，他脑海中不断浮现出那张慈祥的面孔，挥之不去……
在他心中，四长老不仅是他的师父，也是他在这个世界唯一的亲人。
他本是一个孤儿，十年前四长老外出历练，从凶兽口中将他救下，随后将他带回灵虚宗，收他为徒，教导他修行。
当时他刚接触修行便能直接凝聚真气，惊人的悟性轰动了整个灵虚宗。
只是他做梦也没想到等待他的并不是华丽的光环，而是无尽的绝望和黑暗。
修行十年，他连修者的第一个境界凝气境都没能迈进去，因为他无法将凝聚的真气贮存于经脉中。
在修炼一途，莫阳就是名副其实的废物。
这十年来，四长老给他讲述的有关武道的知识以及交给他的功法心诀他都早已熟记在心。
如今这一切对他来说，更像是一种无情的嘲讽。
这些年，四长老一直想尽办法寻求各种方法，不想让他妖孽般的天赋被埋没。
然而，到头来终究是一场空。
半月前，有消息称十万大山中惊现圣草，引得各大宗门前往，四长老听闻消息后，不顾众人劝阻，执意前往。
他知道，这极可能是改变莫阳命运的机会……
结果一去不复返！
随后灵虚宗数位长老暗中前去调查，从一些修者口中得知四长老为了抢夺圣草，结果被大道宗强者出手击杀。
大道宗是一个恐怖到无法想象的巅峰大势力，传承万载岁月，底蕴深不可测。
面对这样的庞然大物，灵虚宗的长老敢怒不敢言，将所有的责任都转移到了莫阳身上。
众多弟子亦是如此，自那开始，莫阳每天面对的便是铺天盖地的恶毒言语。
“明日之后，灵虚宗再无木峰，你自谋生路去吧！”二长老遥遥朝这里看了一眼，丢下这么一句话，随后便转身离去了。
待众弟子离去后，莫阳独自坐在那座衣冠冢前，看着四周荒草萋萋，听着那从耳旁吹过的呜呜风声，心绪低落到了谷底。
“是时候离去了……”
许久，他轻声自语。
content_en:
"Mo Yang, the Fourth Elder is already dead, and you still have the nerve to kneel here? You should die to apologize!"
"The fourth elder died because of you, causing our Lingxu Sect to suffer huge losses. It would be no pity for you to die!"
"After practicing for so many years, you can't even step into the Qi Condensation Realm. Mo Yang, you are a waste. Lingxu Sect does not support waste, so get out of Lingxu Sect!"
"The fourth elder has fallen, and there is no one to protect you anymore. The sect leader has ordered that from tomorrow, Mu Peak will be merged into the main peak. From now on, Lingxu Sect will no longer have a place for you!"
…
In the back mountain of Lingxu Sect, in front of a tomb, a boy of fifteen or sixteen years old was kneeling there with a dull expression.
Facing the various scoldings and curses from more than ten sect disciples, some even pointed their fingers at his forehead...
But he didn't seem to hear it...
His expression was dull and his eyes were empty, like a walking corpse.
He is Mo Yang!
Now Mu Feng is the only remaining disciple.
Mu Feng was originally one of the five peaks of Lingxu Sect, but it has completely declined over the years.
Because the fourth elder often went out to seek various medicinal materials for him, and had no intention of taking care of many matters of Mu Feng, the sect was extremely dissatisfied. The former disciples of Mu Feng were either withdrawn directly by the sect, or joined other peaks on their own, and there was no one left in Mu Feng.
Mo Yang had already anticipated that Mu Feng would be merged this time.
But when the day finally came, he still felt inexplicably disappointed.
Looking at the new tomb in front of him, that kind face kept reappearing in his mind, and he couldn't get rid of it...
In his heart, the Fourth Elder is not only his master, but also his only relative in this world.
He was originally an orphan. Ten years ago, the four elders went out for training and rescued him from the mouth of a vicious beast. They then brought him back to Lingxu Sect, accepted him as a disciple, and taught him how to practice.
At that time, when he first came into contact with cultivation, he could directly condense his true energy, and his amazing understanding shocked the entire Lingxu Sect.
But he never dreamed that what awaited him was not a gorgeous halo, but endless despair and darkness.
After ten years of practice, he could not even reach the first state of Qi condensation as a practitioner because he could not store the condensed Qi in his meridians.
During the journey of cultivation, Mo Yang was a veritable waste.
Over the past ten years, he has memorized the knowledge about martial arts that the Fourth Elder told him and the techniques and secrets given to him.
But...
Now all this is more like a ruthless ridicule to him.
Over the years, the Fourth Elder has been trying his best to find various methods, not wanting his evil talent to be buried.
However, in the end it was all in vain.
Half a month ago, there was news that the sacred grass suddenly appeared in the Shiwan Mountain, attracting all the major sects to go. After hearing the news, the four elders insisted on going despite everyone's dissuasion.
He knew that this was most likely an opportunity to change Mo Yang's destiny...
The results are gone forever!
Later, several elders of the Lingxu Sect secretly went to investigate and learned from some cultivators that the fourth elder was killed by a strong man from the Dao Sect in order to snatch the sacred grass.
The Dao Dao Sect is an unimaginably terrifying pinnacle force, with a heritage that lasts thousands of years and an unfathomable foundation.
Faced with such a behemoth, the elders of Lingxu Sect dared not speak out in anger, and transferred all responsibilities to Mo Yang.
The same is true for many disciples. From then on, Mo Yang faced overwhelming vicious words every day.
"After tomorrow, there will be no more wooden peaks in Lingxu Sect. You can make a living on your own!" The second elder glanced at this place from afar, said this, and then turned and left.
After all the disciples left, Mo Yang sat alone in front of the tomb, looking at the lush grass around him and listening to the whistling wind blowing by his ears, his mood dropped to the bottom of the valley.
"It's time to leave..."
For a long time, he whispered to himself.
